name: inv-1-typescript-compiler-api-seam
description: The TypeScript compiler API enters engine code through exactly three pure seams (G5b ADR-0042, NFR-003, FR-011; G2 AD-6): engine/src/core/owner-verification/mutation-plan.ts (locating mutation sites), engine/src/core/owner-verification/import-graph.ts (reading a module's import and re-export specifiers for sibling coverage) and engine/src/core/skeleton/ts-surface.ts (reading the declaration surfaces of frozen types files and implementation files). Each parses already-read text with ts.createSourceFile and never touches ts.sys, a Program or a language service. This rule refuses any other import (including a bare side-effect import), require or dynamic import of 'typescript' (or a 'typescript/...' subpath) outside tests. Its excludePatterns mirror TYPESCRIPT_COMPILER_API_SEAMS (engine/src/linter/programmatic/no-cross-boundary-imports.ts), and engine/tests/linter/project-lint-rules.test.ts fails when the two drift.
fixHint: Do not import the TypeScript compiler API here. Call mutationPlan (engine/src/core/owner-verification/mutation-plan.ts), moduleEdges (engine/src/core/owner-verification/import-graph.ts) or the surface readers of engine/src/core/skeleton/ts-surface.ts, or add the parsing you need to one of those three pure seams.
